baseline.method: Chromium on GitHub hosted Ubuntu; 3 independent contexts per page/profile; cold visit then same-context reload. Mobile 4x CPU, 150ms added latency, 1.6Mbps down/0.75Mbps up. Not physical Safari or field INP. HTTP cache only, no server cache purge.
